items.note: A.1 states the copy/gather/scatter/side-injection network, the eight-row schedule cancelling arbitrary scratch, net y<-y+x and the three-stage map (x,y)->(-y,x) with restoration (730-738, 762-764). The essential computation that the net change (JV+RG)x is the identity, via the central coefficients |S cap T| mod 2 or (|S cap T|-1)/2 and the side cancellation (742-759), is missing, as are the triple indexing over [100] and the neighbour rule.

The plan follows the paper's invariant argument: edge operator D_vD_u^{-1}, a common frame commuting with the pointwise linear gate, the implemented operator D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1}, and endpoint frames determining each route while intermediate frames are free (804-825).

It states nested nondegenerate labels, only central 3->4 edges decreasing by h, L=Ich, sum of absolute changes Wm-2N+2L and the ratios 100/539 and 101/539 (891-894, 997-1007, 1105-1109). The derivation leaves out the construction itself: the bilinear forms making neighbouring triple lines orthogonal (856-870), the tensor labels A, P, B, Q and the gate-label table (899-988), and the residual table (1021-1043). The method's phrase 'neighbouring labels are nested' blurs the paper's mechanism.

Together A.3.4 and B.2.2 give endpoint difference I_m on every role, frames Phi_M producing the shear H<-H+D on every row, and s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b<W_b m (1138-1153, 1527-1533). The proof is not shown: P_V-P_U has rank dim V - dim U, the -P_{U_a} source matrices give N rank-one exceptions, and the endpoint calculation (1156-1171) is missing.

It states one kernel aI+bX_v per orthonormal residual vector, s_c=W_c m-2N+2L_c<W_c m, and C^{tensor m} on every role after corrections (1214-1228). The method names the phase frames, the H-conjugation and the telescoping, but omits the essential weight-additivity step q_V-q_U = sum wt(v)[v.x] mod 4 with wt(v) odd (1232-1248). It also omits the specific 27-coordinate Z correction on the X_a->Y_a pair (1290-1310).

Across these steps the plan states L/N<1/2, the strict deficits s<Wm, deficits above 20*2^{-50}, tau=sigma=1-2^{-50} and s/W<m^tau (1331-1343). The explicit eta values and the log m<20 exponential estimate (1332-1337) are absent, and A.5 is a bare inference with no method.

It states the O(V) scans and the controlled cyclic shift, and derives the shift faithfully (split at Q-a, reversed merge, b^{O(1)}=O(Q) absorbed; 575-589). It omits multiplication by fixed rational units (569-570, 592-614), which the triangular factors need, and A0.1 has no derivation.

The factorization A=E_1 Pi E_2, the triangular controlled shifts in descending order and the one-interchange realization of each one in Pi follow 1425-1443. The statement drops the setting over Z/q^b with a fixed odd prime q avoiding the denominators (1397, 1404, 1413-1423). The elimination proof of the factorization (1375-1391) is not shown.

The plan reproduces the paper's route step by step: cyclic row split into W role streams, edge shears by recursive interchanges, H<-H+D via the frame identity, the three-step interchange, s calls on volume V/W, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), the geometric sum and the O(V) depth-first schedule (1497-1588).

High digits as the row field with R=q^{2rho}>=W^k, the base-m decomposition with cost O(V) sum a_j m^{j tau}, and binary padding with e=O(u) match 1660-1733. The padding of rows to a multiple of W^k (1684-1690) is not mentioned, and divisibility is needed by the power-width hypothesis. The re-separation of the high parts is also not mentioned.

It follows 1835-1931: the edge frame change as a product of directional kernels, moving residual directions to coordinates by binary row additions (at most m(m-1)+3m), inverse children via (C^{-1})^{tensor f}=(-i)^f Z C Z, exactly s_c children on f=e/m axes, and H_0^{tensor D}=b^D S_D C^{tensor D} S_D.

It covers the eight conditional additions and their parity-flip result (2019-2046), single cyclic shifts per line (2066-2078), the guard set with delta_bad=min{1,80(f-1)2^{-K}} (2081-2103), and the extract/radix-sort/reinsert repair (2157-2185). The cost O(V(L^tau+1)) in the family matches 2195-2207.

Node overhead O(V((eK)^tau+1)), children of volume V/W, the recurrence with F(e)=O(e) below d^beta, and the final O(d^{lambda'}) range match 2286-2304, 2325-2333 and 2393-2445. The plan does not say where the rows come from: the first q_0 chunks are processed individually and used as a row index padded to a multiple of W^{k_0} (2306-2323). It also does not show the internal/leaf sums (2413-2430).

It states the O(Vd^{lambda'}) cost, the error below sqrt2 2^{-p} with disk preservation, and the exact evaluation with Delta=ceil(C_0 d^{C_1})=o(p) guard bits from A(e)<=sA(e/m)+E. These follow the guard-width section and the proof.

Contraction, character cancellation F_t^+F_t^-=t^{-1}I, decimation in frequency with monomial twiddles, bit-reversed storage giving B_tF_t^- and F_t^+B_t^{-1}, the prefix moves and chunk exchanges, and the cost O(Tp[dK+pK^{tau-1}+l d^{lambda'}]) with error sqrt2 l 2^{-p} all follow the paper.
Evaluation at B_0=2^{4p}, the coefficient bound |h_j|<B_0/2, centered-residue recovery, and four products giving O(rp log(rp)) follow the proof.
The normalization F^-(f*g)=M(F^-f)(F^-g), the commutation of the LB permutation with the pointwise product, the error 3delta+eta scaled by M, and M=T/r products all match 3414-3495.

F.1.2 and F.1.4 give P_sF_s=2^{2alpha^2}B_0P_tF_tA and RF_s=2^gamma B_0 Q F_t A correctly, but F.1's headline drops P_s ('A Fourier transform of prime length s equals ...'). The hypotheses gcd(s,t)=1 and theta>p/alpha^4 are omitted. The sub-steps restate the lemma and do not follow the construction of A and B_0 from the Gaussian maps S, T, C, D (3576 onward).
The chirp identity with its period and coefficient check, F^+_s R = R^{-1} F^+_s, commutation with pointwise products and the two normalizations giving (u*v)/S^2 follow 3938-3988.

The sizes b, p=6b, d, T, r and t_i, the prime interval and T/2<S<T are stated. Of the fixed exponents only epsilon and kappa are given (tau, lambda, c, lambda', delta are omitted), and eta=1/(4d) and alpha are not specified. The checks of the exponent conditions (4016-4036) are not shown.

The isomorphism, the triangular coordinate formula, the descending-order controlled shifts and the cost O(Tp d^2(1+l^tau)) follow the paper. The exponents mu_i=P_i^{-1} mod s_i, which make Phi an isomorphism, are never defined.

The exact twist (well-definedness, diagonal form, wrap-sign check, M_C=D_- iota^{-1} M_r(iota D_+ f, iota D_+ g)=(f*g)/T) is faithful to 4303-4342. The computed convolution with approximate twist factors and its error contribution (4349-4413) is not covered.
The source transform composition with exact counterpart RF_s, conjugation for the opposite sign, and the six-step pipeline with the two occurrences of S match 4456-4540.

The chain E_ring<5TL, chirp <8TL, E_s=9*2^gamma TL, E_w<28*2^gamma T^2L, final error <448b 2^{-3b/4}<1/2, and the carry bound follow the paper. The use of gamma<=b/4 in the last step is left implicit.

V=Tp, min g_i=2^{-181}=2kappa, the derivation of the binding chunk-exchange margin epsilon c(1-tau), absorption of logs and setup, and the final bound with a schoolbook cutoff are all present. The seven normalized cost rows of Table tab:costs and the other six margins are neither listed nor derived.
No step says that the bound refutes an eventual n lg n lower bound (liminf T_A(n)/(n lg n)=0). S0 only lists 'n-log-n-barrier' as background.

errors.says: A Fourier transform of prime length s equals 2^{2alpha^2}B_0P_tF_tA for a power-of-two length t>s.
errors.paper: The identity is P_sF_s=2^{2alpha^2}B_0P_tF_tA, with P_s on the left, under gcd(s,t)=1 and theta=t/s-1>p/alpha^4 (3550-3563). F_s alone is not equal to the right side.

errors.says: Method: choose labels as tensor products of triple lines so that neighbouring labels are nested.
errors.paper: Neighbouring triple lines are orthogonal under the chosen form (869-870), and that orthogonality is what makes the labels on each edge comparable, for example P x <t_X> in P x t_Y^perp (946-953). 'Neighbouring labels are nested' misplaces the mechanism.

errors.says: With the projection matrices as frames, every input role sees endpoint difference I_m.
errors.paper: The frames are the address shears Phi_{M_v}, where M_v=P_U at gates and sinks and -P_{U_a} at the X_a sources. The negative source projection is what gives P_{U_a^perp}+P_{U_a}=I_m and the N rank-one exceptions (1115-1130, 1162-1171).

chain: The tree follows the paper's route from start to finish: the scalar exchange network, frames, labels with L<N/2, the shear interface, the matrix-shear cost, the power-width recurrence and arbitrary widths. These are then used in the butterfly layer, the synthetic transforms, resampling with chirp and permutation cancellation, the CRT map and twist, exact recovery and cost accounting, ending at O(n(lg n)^{1-kappa}). It thins out in the network section, where the label construction and the rank-equals-dimension-change step behind s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b are asserted rather than shown. The Gaussian resampling identity is cited rather than derived, and the refutation of the n log n conjecture is never stated.

steps.note: The exchange (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) with scratch restoration is stated precisely. The defining quantities h=100, the triple-indexed banks, N=binom(h,3)^3 and m=h^3 appear nowhere in the plan, so I chose the conservative verdict.
A common frame commuting with the pointwise gate, the implemented operator D_out S D_in^{-1}, and the edge cost reduced to a change of frame are all present.

It gives nondegenerate subspaces built from triple indicators with dimension m, comparable labels on every edge, and only the central 3->4 edges decreasing, each losing h. The orthogonality of neighbouring triples that makes this work is blurred (see errors).
The plan speaks of 'total edge rank' and counting dimension changes, but never states that P_V-P_U has rank dim V - dim U. It also omits the N rank-one source exceptions that turn -2N into -N.
It has sum |Delta dim| = Wm-2N+2L, L=Ich, and s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b.
It gives L_b/N=100/539 (101/539 complex) below 1/2 and the deficit N-2L_b>0, so s<Wm.
It states endpoint difference I_m on every input role and the resulting shear H<-H+D on every row, including scratch rows. The -P_{U_a} source mechanism is not given.
A rank-a shear is factored as E_1 Pi E_2 and costs exactly a interchanges plus O(V), so a node makes s recursive calls.
Children of volume V/W, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), s/W<m^tau with tau=1-2^{-50} from deficits above 20*2^{-50}, and F_k=O(e^tau) are all present. The log m<20 estimate is not mentioned.

central.summary: The plan reconstructs the central chain from frames through labels, budget, strict saving, endpoint identity, edges as recursive calls and the recurrence (7 of 9 steps). It is thin at two points. The fixed network lacks its defining parameters h=100, N and m. The link 'edge rank equals label dimension change, with N rank-one source exceptions' is asserted only through the final formula s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b.
